**Edge Capture Metric**  
- Formula: `edge_capture = sum(engine_pnl_on_winning_days) - sum(max(0, engine_loss_on_losing_days))`  
- Threshold: Minimum 771 (50% of max possible 1542) for candidate retention  
- Rejection condition: Any candidate with edge_capture < 771 is discarded, regardless of aggregate Sharpe ratio  
- Final scoring: `final_score = edge_capture × aggregate_sharpe` (Sharpe/P&L used for tiebreakers)
